description.text: Please contact us before application to confirm whether this English-medium program would be open this year.

duration.text: The Computer Software and Theory at Guizhou University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2638 USD/per year ￥ 19000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Postgraduate school transcript 4. Master’s degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5. Health certificate (optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Resume Written in Chinese or in English 7. Two recommendation letters (optional)

requirements.text: 1. Healthy foreign citizens with master degree; 2. IELTS 6.5 for English-taught programs and New HSK 5 for Chinese-taught programs; 3. Willing to obey laws and regulations of China and school.
